propositions: Copilot, Codex, and Claude MCP clients must be configured to connect to the rebar MCP server over remote HTTP using static bearer PAT authentication.

Each client requires a distinct config file shape (Copilot: mcp-config.json with headers map, Codex: config.toml with bearer_token_env_var, Claude: .mcp.json with headers object) sourcing credentials from environment variables rather than committed secrets.

A hermetic test must verify that real example configs load correctly, resolve bearer tokens from environment variables, and successfully call a read-tool (ticket show/list) against a loopback rebar-mcp HTTP instance.
The test must confirm that absent or invalid bearer tokens result in 401 responses and that no PAT literals are committed in example configs.

Per-client CLI acceptance checks must verify that copilot mcp get, codex mcp list, and claude mcp list can load and list the rebar server when the respective client binaries are installed, with graceful skip-with-reason when binaries are absent.
